# GatewayController

## Constructor

```ts
new GatewayController(host: HTMLElement, options?: GatewayOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `parse` | `(res: Response) => Promise<string>` | no | Parse the fetch response into a string. Default: `res.text()` |
| `serialize` | `(content: string) => BodyInit` | no | Build the save request body from content. Default: plain text body |
| `contentType` | `string` | no | Content-Type header for save requests. Default: `text/plain` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `markDirty()` | `—` | `void` |
| `markClean()` | `—` | `void` |
| `abort()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { GatewayController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new GatewayController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
